threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for directions to the nearest tube and someone looks at you like you’ve grown a second head—Dalston doesn’t do that kind of travel.
Last night on the 37, a guy was singing loudly about his cat. Everyone just nodded along. Only in Peckham could you get a concert and a late bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I heard someone serenading their cat from the window while the kebab shop down the street blasted techno at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find outdoor movie screenings in empty swimming pools during summer. It's a vibe that feels uniquely Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their indifference to the BART breakdowns; tourists are the ones looking at their phones in panic when the trains don’t come.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a Muni driver giving directions to a lost tourist. It’s those small moments that make the city feel alive, even at rush hour.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals sip café amb llet in fancy places, but most of us grab a quick cortado at the corner bar. It's all about speed.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell when they walk too slowly—stopping to gawk at each Gaudí building like it's the first time they've seen a city.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the 38' instead of just '38'. Locals don’t bother with ‘the’—it’s all about speed when you’re waiting for a bus.
Caught a guy on the 59 last night trying to barter a half-eaten pasty for a bus ticket. Driver just shook his head and laughed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a toddler gleefully feeding the pigeons a leftover döner in Hermannplatz, I realized this was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a dog park with a bar serving craft beer right next to it. The pups roam free while their humans sip ales. Perfect combo.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their ability to navigate BART delays, but a newbie stares blankly at the schedule app like it's hieroglyphics.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that had to stop because a guy was arguing with a pigeon. That pigeon stood its ground. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists miss that the best local bars close early, thinking they’ll find a late-night vibe like in tourist traps. It’s the locals' time to unwind.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still frown at the late-night noise; locals just shrug and carry on. It's like an unwritten rule here.
